what: Lafaw hindcast verification, Erbil, nine wadi basins
period: 2024-03 to 2026-09 (every daily issue available from the ECMWF IFS 0.25 previous-runs archive; ICON and GFS for the multi-model variants)
forecast: Open-Meteo previous-runs API, deterministic runs of ECMWF IFS 0.25, ICON and GFS; basin rain at the catchment centroid; SCS curve-number runoff with antecedent wetness; peak flow vs Gumbel reference flows Q2/Q5/Q20
observed: ECMWF IFS analysis daily basin rain (NASA GPM IMERG and gauges when available) scored with the same rule family (fair events)
event_definition: a day is an event at a level when the observed basin rain and wetness, through the same runoff rule, reach that level

warning.note: POD about 0.5, FAR 0.73 to 0.90 for every model and every combination tried; systematic

what_it_means: watch level: four of five runoff days flagged one day ahead, half the flags without a runoff day
lead time from 1 to 3 days costs little skill
warning level is not yet usable as a hard trigger; thresholds and the observed product are what the first season's gauges will fix
caveats: deterministic runs, not the 51-member ensemble used operationally (the ensemble archive starts later)
observed rain is a reanalysis, not a gauge, for most of the period
the 12 April 2023 event lies before the archive and could not be hindcast
source_documents: docs/hindcast_erbil.md, docs/hindcast_multimodel_erbil.md and docs/outlook_thresholds.md in the Lafaw repository
